name: Antapex
description: Higher-level targets only receive +2 bonus to Fort Defence (rather than +5) against blue magick spells you cast.

name: Synastry
description: Choose an additional star sign to treat as compatible (cannot pick an incompatible sign).

name: Synchronicity
description: Primary action. Designate target within 12 squares. Share magick buffs if compatible; share status effects and penalties if incompatible until end of encounter.

name: Lookout
description: Distance penalties for Perception reduced to -2 per 10 squares. Cover penalties reduced to -2 (total cover -5).

name: Windrigger
description: Minor action once/encounter. Move occupied vessel up to half speed without provoking counterattacks.

name: Helmsman
description: Reroll Pilot checks, keeping the second result.

name: Facade
description: Deceptive appearance penalty for race/gender/size reduced from -5 to -2.

name: Incognito
description: Minor action when adjacent to 2+ creatures. Gain total concealment from non-adjacent creatures.

name: Subterfuge
description: Swap initiative rolls with a willing ally at the start of encounter.

name: Derecho Blitz
description: Act before all enemies while piloting to execute an immediate free attack run before any other action.

name: Iron Wing
description: Once per encounter when damage exceeds threshold, prevent your airship from moving down the Break Gauge.

name: Jet Stream
description: Once per encounter, ignore rough terrain imposed by storms until start of next turn.

name: Prevailing Winds
description: Gain 1 extra movement square for every 2 points beating Pilot DC on full speed ahead.

name: Savage Squall
description: Need not move in a straight line when making an airship attack run.

name: Sirocco Break
description: Piloted airship takes half damage from area attacks (none on a miss).

name: Winding Gale
description: Immediately regain use of Naval Combat upon successfully avoiding an attack.

name: Zephyr Strike
description: Airship gains resistance to damage when executing a ram action.

name: Ad Astra
description: Synchronicity designates targets up to Mind modifier (any combination of compatible/incompatible).

name: Aevum
description: May cast White Magick spells as Blue Magick spells.

name: Eclipse
description: DC 20 Spellcraft check. Selected star sign becomes neutral to all others until end of encounter.

name: Grand Trine
description: Use Trine within 12 squares and heal an ally for the HP you lost.

name: Prescience
description: Roll 1d20 at initiative. Replace any ally's d20 roll once/encounter, or force an enemy to take it with a Spellcraft check.

name: Retrograde
description: Once per day, raise Temporal Shift DC to 35 to affect all targets within 6 squares.

name: Temporal Shift
description: DC 25 Spellcraft check. Target reverts to exact status, HP, MP, and Break Step from your previous turn.

name: Trine
description: Reaction: Reduce ally's incoming damage by half; take the other half as direct damage.

name: Big Pharma
description: Primary action: Roll item availability for a potion; immediately apply effect to ally within 6 squares for 2x GP cost.

name: Black Market
description: Reroll d100 search checks for rare items; item cost increases by 1.5x.

name: Full Leverage
description: Persuasion vs Will (6-sq cone). Enemies using primary/all-out action award you 200gp x class level.

name: Hedge Risk
description: Reaction: Halve incoming damage by spending 10x the negated damage in gold.

name: Low Leverage
description: Persuasion vs Will (6-sq cone). Enemies using minor/all-out action award you 100gp x class level.

name: Payoff
description: Spend 100gp x target level on Persuasion vs Will. Target ceases treating party as enemies (can turn into ally at +10 over Will).

name: Pay to Win
description: Spend up to 1,000gp to deal 1d6 unaspected damage per 100gp spent.

name: Takeover
description: Higher-level enemies only receive +2 Will defense against Leverage abilities.

name: Addendum
description: Spend 1/4 max MP: Allies within 4 squares convert weapon damage to chosen elemental type.

name: Enlightenment
description: Increases Educated bonus to +10 for untrained Lore (+5 if trained).

name: Eureka
description: Rolling <= 20 on Tabula Rasa d% restores MP equal to Int modifier.

name: Excogitation
description: Once per encounter, reroll Tabula Rasa d% check.

name: Paradigm Shift
description: Scrutiny affects all non-humanoid creatures sharing the target's name.

name: Scrutiny
description: Lore check against target: downgrades damage immunity to resistance, or removes resistance.

name: Sublimation
description: Increase primary action cast to all-out action to convert elemental damage type.

name: Wandwork
description: Add Int modifier to damage when attacking with staves.
